# @three-ws/metaplex-agent-mcp

> Deploy AI agents on-chain into the Metaplex Agent Registry on Solana: one atomic transaction mints a Metaplex Core asset (data: URI metadata, verified creator, royalties, immutable metadata) and registers its EIP-8004 agent identity, so the agent lands with its own on-chain wallet. Agents sign with their own key; people sign with Phantom, Solflare, or any Solana wallet via the prepare/send flow. A flat mainnet deploy fee funds $THREE buybacks and is waived for $THREE holders. Every Core plugin and every metadata field is customizable.

@three-ws/metaplex-agent-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/metaplex-agent-mcp`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/metaplex-agent-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/metaplex-agent-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
